_written: 2026-10-10, before any radar time series for these sites was computed or plotted. Segments drawn from Sentinel-2 imagery, published zone boxes from ../zones.py and compass geometry only.

rules.baseline: 12 months ending 12 months before the reference date D (i.e. D-24mo .. D-12mo)
rules.search_window: D-12mo .. D-4 weeks (a detection must start at least 4 weeks before D)

insar_velocity.statistic: segment LOS displacement change over the trailing 60 days (median over points/pixels, minus the control median), mm
insar_velocity.threshold: outside baseline mean +/- 3 SD AND |change| >= 15 mm

amplitude.statistic: share of segment pixels whose VV dB (3x3 boxcar) differs from the median of the previous 5 passes by > 2 dB, minus the same share over control pixels

rules.false_alarms: Apply the identical rule with D moved to every 1 July / 1 January in the archive and to every segment; report how often it fires where no geotechnical event is documented.
rules.lead: D minus the first epoch of the detecting run. Lead over disclosure is reported against the public disclosure date, which can differ from D.

bingham.control: points 3.0-4.5 km from pit bottom (natural ground and mine surroundings outside the pit)

events.name: 2024 south-wall highwall movement
events.disclosure: 2024-07-16 Rio Tinto Q2 2024 operations review: mine plan changed to manage geotechnical risk; 2024-10-16 Q3 review: highwall movement monitored along two major faults during Q2, limits access to the south-wall primary ore face (~50 kt Cu in 2024, impact into 2025-26)

events.name: Leo SE-wall failure (19 Mt)
events.disclosure: 2021-06-02 local press (Salt Lake Tribune), slide anticipated by Kennecott monitoring; mining halted 2021-05-30

expectations: Amplitude: expected NOT to show precursors (cm-scale creep is invisible to backscatter); may show the failure itself. InSAR: precursors plausible only where coherence survives; active benches and fresh heap lifts decorrelate.
